title: Plan
description: A plan written by the planning agent and rendered by lib/plan/viewer.html for the person who decides it. Text fields marked as markdown accept CommonMark; raw HTML in them is shown as text. Fields described as filled in by the generator are never written by the planning agent.

title.description: The plan's name, a few words.

problem.description: One paragraph: what is wrong today and why it matters.

goal.description: What the change is for, in the user's terms.

doneWhen.description: What must be true for the whole plan to be done.

notDoing.description: What is deliberately out of scope.

survey.description: Facts about the code and its dependencies that the plan is built on. Steps refer to them with fact blocks.

decisions.description: Decisions that apply to the whole plan rather than one step.

proposals.description: Proposals that apply to the whole plan rather than one step.

steps.description: In landing order. A step's number is its position; steps have no IDs.

openId.description: A short snake_case name the agent chooses for the question, usually the name the decision will carry once answered, e.g. opening_type.

agentId.description: A short snake_case name the agent chooses for the choice, e.g. opening_drawing.

cut.description: Why this step is a separate step.

test.description: teaches: landing the previous step teaches what this one should be. oneRead: this step and the previous one together exceed one read. Leave it out only if no test applies; the page flags that on every step after the first.

resolvesRisk.description: The risk this step resolves, stated as what could be wrong: "the cache key may not survive a process restart".

summary.description: Two to four sentences on what the step does. Type-level detail goes in afterItLands.

afterItLands.description: What each type the step touches becomes once it lands, and what it removes and where those removed things still appear. Free-form blocks.

gate.description: What must be true for this step to be done.

proposedChange.description: The change for the person to review: diffs, sketches, and anything that explains them, in reading order.

reliesOn.description: What the step stands on, in reading order: survey facts (with the evidence this step needs), and anything else, each with a caption saying why the step relies on it.

open.description: Choices still waiting on the user.

user.description: Choices the user made, and implementation shapes the user sketched.

id.description: Unique across the plan. Usually the key the decision will have once it is answered.

gitPath.description: The file or folder the answer lands in, relative to the repo root. The page flags a 'now' question without one.

when.description: trial: the user judges it by eye when the step is tried, not before.

id.description: Unique across the plan's open questions and proposals; the name of the choice.

over.description: The alternative it weighed and passed over, left out when none was weighed. Rendered after the word 'over'.

status.description: notRaised: the user has not yet replied having seen it. noObjection: the user replied having seen it and did not object. leftToAgent: left to the implementer to decide in the code. approved / objected: the user's answer, which leaves it a proposal: a recommendation the user accepted is approved here, never moved to the decisions.

key.description: snake_case name for the decision, e.g. opening_shape.

choice.description: The outcome the user chose, as what they will observe. Never the mechanism, even one the agent offered and the user said yes to.

sketch.description: An implementation shape the user suggested, written in place of choice. The page marks it as a sketch.

why.description: The user's reason, which the implementer weighs the decision by.

over.description: What the user weighed and rejected, left out when nothing was weighed. Rendered after the word 'over'.

decided.description: When it was decided, as an ISO date. Kept for the implementer; not shown on the page.

id.description: Unique across the plan and never reused.

caption.description: The sentence that introduces the block.

about.description: Open questions this block is about. The page shows them on the block as well as in the Decisions box.

block.description: Any block. row and fact blocks may hold leaf blocks, one level deep.

leafBlock.description: Any block except row and fact.

codeBlock.description: Existing code, shown exactly. Use sketch for code that is not exact.

label.description: What the block's header shows instead of the path, e.g. 'bevy_gizmos 0.19.1 · src/retained.rs'.

oneOf.description: A file in the repo. Read from disk when the page is generated, or from git at commit when one is given.
Any file on disk, such as a dependency's source in Cargo's registry.

firstLine.description: Number the lines from here. Without it the lines are unnumbered.

resolved.description: Filled in by the generator for gitPath and absolutePath sources.

error.description: Filled in by the generator when the source could not be read.

diffBlock.description: An exact change to one file, as unified diff text. One file per diff; never mix files in one block.

gitPath.description: The one file this diff changes, relative to the repo root.

label.description: Header text instead of the path.

sketchBlock.description: The shape of a change to one file, not exact code. One file per sketch; never mix files in one block. Lines starting with + or - are shown as added or removed.

gitPath.description: The one file this sketch changes, relative to the repo root. It may not exist yet.

resolved.description: Filled in by the generator, usually as a data: URI.

error.description: Filled in by the generator when the image could not be read.

factBlock.description: A survey fact this step relies on. The page shows the fact's claim; evidence here is what this step needs to show under it.

rowBlock.description: Two or more blocks side by side on wide screens.

reliesOnItem.description: A survey fact, or any other block with a caption saying why the step relies on it.
